text:
ops-bot: Heads-up: planned maintenance tomorrow 02:00-03:00 UTC for eu-west1 serving nodes. Expected short KV compaction and kernel patch. No customer-facing downtime expected, but we'll run an evacuation test first. :calendar:
anna: acked. I'll be primary on-call. I'll open the bridge at 01:45 and start preflight checks at 01:30. :phone:
incident-bot: Pager rules: if any region hits >5% 5xx or tail latency > 2s, page oncall. Auto-fallback to smaller model variant enabled.
mike: I'll own the drain/evac play. Quick checklist below — copy to runbook if helpful:
```
- verify rolling drain config
- confirm KV cache persist settings
- confirm fallback model variants warm
- prepare patch rollback artifacts
- notify support & comms
```
luke: Comms note: status page entry prepared. Draft severity: informational -> we will update to 'maintenance' at start of window. Template in thread.
emma: Support: pre-bake customer emails for customers with reserved capacity and high SLAs. Use this short line: "We are performing a brief maintenance in eu-west1; no interruption expected. We'll update if anything changes."
jessica: Customer success: I'll flag top 20 customers and be on standby to send targeted notices if we see perf regressions.
anna: Bridge link: https://meet.redwood/bridge/maintenance-1767777777 — I'll create the incident pin. Please join by 01:40 UTC.
incident-bot: Created incident channel #incident-1767777777 for postmortem and logs aggregation. Auto-attach traces if error rate spikes.
mike: Preflight: can someone run `kubectl get pods -n serving --selector=region=eu-west1` 30m before window and paste status? I want baseline.
luke: Statuspage draft (copy below). We'll push at 02:00 and update on completion.
```
[Status] Scheduled maintenance in eu-west1 (02:00-03:00 UTC)
Impact: Serving nodes in eu-west1 will be drained briefly for compaction and kernel updates. We do not expect customer-facing downtime. If any issues occur, we will update severity and provide ETA.
```
emma: Customer email template (short):
```
Subject: Planned maintenance in eu-west1 — no expected interruption
Hi <Customer>,
We will perform a brief maintenance on our eu-west1 serving cluster on <date> 02:00-03:00 UTC. We do not expect any service interruption; we will update you if anything changes.
Thanks,
Redwood Inference Operations
```
anna: Confirmed timeline: 01:30 preflight, 01:40 bridge open, 01:45 drain dry-run, 02:00 start window. If any page during window, escalate to SRE lead and change statuspage to Major Incident.
mike: I'll keep a quick script ready to rollback patch: `./tools/patch_rollback.sh --region eu-west1 --force` — will paste output if used.
luke: Reminder: metrics alert rule to mute non-critical noise during drain: I'll apply temporary suppression at 01:50.
jessica: I'll stand by for customer DMs if anything goes sideways.
incident-bot: If a page fires, auto-run `incident-runbook --id 1767777777` and record timeline.
anna: Post-maint completion message: I'll post final note in this thread and update statuspage to "resolved" with duration.
mike: Thanks all. Quick check: who is backup oncall after 02:30? @luke?
luke: I can backfill if needed at 02:30-04:00.
anna: Great. See you on bridge. :white_check_mark:
(01:55) anna: preflight checks green; pods healthy baseline attached; ready to proceed.
(03:05) anna: maintenance complete. All nodes back, post-maint KPIs within normal range. Updating statuspage now. :white_check_mark:
luke: statuspage updated to resolved and customer email queued for immediate send to reserved-capacity customers.
jessica: Notified top customers via DM. No active complaints as of now.
emma: Closing notes: log collection is uploaded to S3: s3://ops-archives/maint-1767777777/logs — will trigger postmortem template if any alerts fired.
anna: Thanks everyone — filing short postmortem later today if anything to note. Closing channel in 24h. :lock:
